quests.title: Returns at Carlton
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. I am sending back 68 papers a day from Carlton and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: the returns stack, at its worst
the distributor needs to see the size of it

quests.title: The Better Rate, Carlton
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. They will drop my Carlton order if I can show $77 of turnover on the other side of the shop by every second Friday. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: $77, and cards and stationery count
sell anything, I am not proud

quests.title: The Carlton Round
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. I do the Carlton round from ten past five and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: the end of the round, where it starts
whoever is on that street at that hour

quests.title: The Dog on Ash Street, Carlton
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. There is a dog on the Carlton round that has had two of my bags and a milk crate that was not even mine. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: you will want your wits about you
the owner, not the dog, I am not a monster
tell me it is sorted

quests.title: The Syndicate, Carlton
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. Nine of us at Carlton have gone in on the same numbers since every second Friday and one of us has stopped putting money in. I am aware how that sounds. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: the house of the one who stopped
$68, which is his share since he stopped
I want it said out loud, not in the group chat

quests.title: The Other Agency, Carlton
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. The agency at Kogarah closed six months before Carlton started struggling, and I would very much like to know what they know. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: the shop is shut, the family is not
whatever they say, say it slowly to me

quests.title: The Unclaimed Falcon, Lindfield
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. There has been a car in the Lindfield yard since a Tuesday with a laminated notice on the passenger seat and no owner answering. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: the car and the plate together
I have to prove I tried before I can move it

quests.title: Storage Fees, Lindfield
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. Now that it is documented, Lindfield is owed $68 in storage and the only person who can pay it is the person not answering. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: $68, from him or from the scrap
either way it comes off my floor

quests.title: First Year, Lindfield
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. I am in my first year at Lindfield and I have to log 27 hours on a job I am not allowed to touch on my own. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: the supplier, two streets over
and get him a coffee, it helps
sign the book and I owe you

quests.title: The Air Line, Lindfield
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. Somebody has been coming into the Lindfield yard after two in the afternoon to use the air line, and last week they used the compressor as well. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: the ones who think the yard is public
the gate they are getting through

quests.title: My Own Car, Lindfield
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. My car has been at Lindfield since a Tuesday and every time I ring, the quote has grown by about $27. I am aware how that sounds. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: stand in the office where they can see you
the job card on the wall, all of it
now I know what I am arguing about

quests.title: The Assessor, Lindfield
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. The insurance assessor who signs off every job at Lindfield works out of Roseville, and he has never once seen the car he is assessing. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: catch him before he goes out on the road
I want to hear how he does it

quests.title: Dumped Out the Back, Bexley North
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. People leave things at the Bexley North roller door after first light and by morning it is rained on and it is our problem and our tip fee. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: the pile, on a bad morning
the council will not act without one of these

quests.title: The Tip Fee, Bexley North
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. The photos worked, which means Bexley North can claim back the $68 we have paid to throw away other people's furniture since every second Friday. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: $68, and every receipt counts
I will do the form if you do the walking

quests.title: The Good Box, Bexley North
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. Something came into Bexley North on every second Friday in a box of paperbacks that I do not think the family meant to give away. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: the address on the donation slip
the thing itself, before it goes back
I would rather give it back than sell it

quests.title: Sorting Room, Bexley North
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. Two people have been coming into the Bexley North sorting room since every second Friday and taking the good stock before it reaches the floor, and one of them volunteers here. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: catch them at the back door
$9, which is what the good stock made last month

quests.title: The Van, Bexley North
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. I do the Bexley North pick-ups in a van with 9 thousand on it and a door that only opens if you know about it. I am aware how that sounds. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: come out to Kingsgrove with me, it is a two-person lift
we will stop on the way, my shout

quests.title: Head Office, Bexley North
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. Everything Bexley North cannot sell goes to a warehouse at Kingsgrove, and nobody there has ever answered a phone in my hearing. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: turn up in person, that is the trick
tell me there is a person in there
